subject: ela
intro: Analyze how an author unfolds ideas.

items.prompt:
The sequence in which an author makes points is their:
A) order
B) font
C) page count

Linking one idea to another is a:
A) connection
B) title
C) rhyme

Authors unfold their ideas in a:
A) deliberate order
B) random pile
C) single word

An author opens with a surprising statistic, then explains its causes and consequences. Opening with the statistic mainly:
A) hooks the reader before building understanding
B) is random
C) hides the topic
items.answer: A) hooks the reader before building understanding

steps: Hook then develop. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) hooks the reader before building understanding

items.prompt:
An author writes, 'This pattern also explains the later crisis...' This mainly:
A) draws a connection to an earlier point
B) starts an unrelated topic
C) ends the text
items.answer: A) draws a connection to an earlier point

solution.answer: A) draws a connection to an earlier point

items.prompt:
Why does the ORDER of points matter?
A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas
B) it never matters
C) only length matters
items.answer: A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas

steps: Order aids clarity. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas

items.prompt:
An author traces an epidemic's origin, then its spread, then the response. This order BEST helps the reader:
A) understand how the crisis developed step by step
B) get confused
C) skip the analysis
items.answer: A) understand how the crisis developed step by step

steps: Sequence builds understanding. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) understand how the crisis developed step by step

items.prompt:
To analyze how an author UNFOLDS an analysis, examine:
A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them
B) only the word count
C) only the title
items.answer: A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them

steps: Order + development + connections. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them
